basicDifferentialDrive.a.comment: distancia en x entre cm y ruedas

basicDifferentialDrive.b.comment: distancia en y entre cm y rueda

basicDifferentialDrive.chassis.inertial_.comment: =false. Si 'true', se consideran efectos inerciales de masa e inercia rotante

equation: assert(basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.lateral_friction >= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow and basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.lateral_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, "Variable violating min/max constraint: MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow <= basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.lateral_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, has value: " + String(basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.lateral_friction, "d"));

assert(basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.longitudinal_friction >= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow and basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.longitudinal_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, "Variable violating min/max constraint: MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow <= basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.longitudinal_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, has value: " + String(basicDifferentialDrive.w0f.longitudinal_friction, "d"));

assert(basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.lateral_friction >= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow and basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.lateral_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, "Variable violating min/max constraint: MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow <= basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.lateral_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, has value: " + String(basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.lateral_friction, "d"));

assert(basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.longitudinal_friction >= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow and basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.longitudinal_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, "Variable violating min/max constraint: MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroFlow <= basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.longitudinal_friction <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.FrictionConstraint.zeroEffort, has value: " + String(basicDifferentialDrive.w1f.longitudinal_friction, "d"));

assert(basicDifferentialDrive.tractionInputType >= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.TractionInputs.position and basicDifferentialDrive.tractionInputType <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.TractionInputs.power, "Variable violating min/max constraint: MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.TractionInputs.position <= basicDifferentialDrive.tractionInputType <= MobileRobots.MobileCarts.Types.TractionInputs.power, has value: " + String(basicDifferentialDrive.tractionInputType, "d"));
